title: [9월 28일 마감시황] 코스피 급락에도 돈은 돌았다…지수보다 먼저 봐야 할 수급 변화ㅣ홍선애, 이권희, 김장열 [클로징벨 라이브]

claims.claim_text: On 2026-09-28, KOSPI closed near 6,889 after falling about 2.7%, while KOSDAQ rose about 0.25% to 846; investor flows and market breadth showed gains outside large-cap stocks.

numeric_parse.claimed: KOSPI ≈6,889, −2.7%; KOSDAQ ≈846, +0.25%; foreign −₩3.6tn, institutions −₩1.3tn, individuals +₩3.2tn; 611 gainers, 249 decliners

claims.investor_implication: Confirm exchange closing statistics before relying on the breadth-versus-index thesis.

claims.claim_text: Samsung Electronics and SK hynix each fell about 5% on September 28 and underperformed cited overseas semiconductor comparators since July 31; rates and flows were proposed as causes.

numeric_parse.claimed: Both stocks down about 5%; SK hynix ADR +33%, Micron +31%, Taiwan index +11%, SOX +12% since July 31

claims.investor_implication: Do not use the relative-performance or causal narrative without matched-date prices and flow data.

claims.claim_text: US 10-year and 30-year Treasury yields were about 5.2% and 5.5%, respectively, with a claimed high since 2004.
claims.investor_implication: Verify the dated Treasury series before using these rates to explain equity moves.

claims.claim_text: A Blue Owl-linked Oracle data-center project received a force-majeure notice and faced a roughly seven-month delay on an approximately $18 billion project; Oracle CDS rose from about 200 to 240 bp and about 20% of global AI-infrastructure demand was affected.

numeric_parse.claimed: $18bn project; ≈7-month delay; CDS ≈200→240 bp; ≈20% of global AI-infrastructure demand

claims.investor_implication: Treat the project, credit-spread, and global-demand figures as unconfirmed risk scenarios.

claims.claim_text: The speaker cited Micron gross-margin levels of 84.9%, 86%, and at least 87%, revenue of about $50.4 billion and $57 billion, and long-term supply agreements as earnings checkpoints.
claims.investor_implication: Do not model earnings from these numbers; obtain the original audio and Micron's dated IR materials.

claims.claim_text: Solar shares rose by the stated percentages after an interpreted reduction in concern about easing US restrictions on Chinese panels following a US–China summit.

numeric_parse.claimed: Hanwha Solutions ≈+14%; OCI Holdings >+10%; HD Hyundai Energy Solutions ≈+4%; CS Wind ≈+5%

claims.investor_implication: Separate any verified stock returns from the unverified policy explanation.

claims.claim_text: ESS and data-center power-demand expectations helped battery shares; EcoPro BM rose about 6%, Seojin System about 11%, SK Innovation received prismatic LFP/ESS orders, and ESS demand could reach 1 TW.

numeric_parse.claimed: EcoPro BM ≈+6%; Seojin System ≈+11%; ESS demand up to 1 TW

claims.investor_implication: Require contract terms and a dated demand forecast before attributing earnings to ESS growth.

claims.claim_text: HLB hit its daily upper price limit following favorable cholangiocarcinoma news; Lunit rose about 19%, and Lunit, VUNO, and JLK had order or overseas-expansion developments.
claims.investor_implication: Verify the precise drug-development milestone and realized medical-AI revenue before drawing conclusions from the reported rallies.

claims.claim_text: LG Electronics rose about 4% intraday and closed about 2% higher amid Nvidia-related cooling expectations; LG Innotek moved on substrate rotation, while reported Nvidia glass-substrate interest remained commercially uncertain.
claims.investor_implication: Do not equate thematic price moves or reported evaluation with signed contracts or revenue.

claims.claim_text: The speaker cited S&P 500 EPS growth figures of 34%, 15%, and a Goldman Sachs reduction to 11%, plus a CAPE reading near 41.
claims.investor_implication: Exclude these valuation and earnings inputs until their dates, definitions, and original sources are established.

entities.name: 코스피·코스닥
claims: 코스피 하락에도 상승 종목이 하락 종목보다 많아 지수와 종목별 체감 흐름이 달랐다고 설명했다.
numeric_claims: 9월 28일 종가 기준 코스피 약 2.7% 하락·6,889선, 코스닥 약 0.25% 상승·846선으로 언급했다.
코스피 외국인 약 3조6천억 원, 기관 약 1조3천억 원 순매도와 개인 약 3조2천억 원 순매수를 언급했다.
verification_notes: 공개 시장 스냅샷은 조회됐지만 영상 주장을 직접 대조할 수 있는 검증 규칙이 없어 미검증으로 분류했습니다.

entities.name: 오라클
claims: 출연자는 블루아울이 관여한 오라클 데이터센터 사업에서 불가항력 통보와 지연 문제가 불거져 AI 인프라의 전력·인허가·자금 조달 실행 위험이 부각됐다고 설명했다.
numeric_claims: 관련 사업 규모를 180억 달러, 지연 기간을 약 7개월로 언급했다.
오라클 CDS 프리미엄이 약 200bp에서 240bp 안팎으로 상승했다고 말했다.
오라클 관련 수요가 세계 AI 인프라에 약 20% 영향을 준다는 출연자 추정치를 제시했다.
